references.phrase: relatively prime polynomials f and f′

references.context: Field theory: irreducible polynomial over a field
Polynomial algebra: formal derivative of a univariate polynomial, including positive characteristic
Field theory: multiple root or multiplicity of polynomial root over an algebraic closure

references.disposition: The coprimality criterion and no-repeated-root property concern the same polynomial; no irreducibility condition on f′ is required.

review_rationale: Read the two equivalent characterizations in their field-coefficient context: the formal derivative is coprime to f, equivalently no repeated roots in an algebraic closure. Do not conflate a zero derivative with separability.
